items.title: 68437_Charles Thompson oral history interview
items.q: And of course later on Billy Berg had one too in Hollywood... and on to California where we played in Billy Berg's famous jazz club.

ctx.x: He named Billie Lady Day and he named you Sir Charles.

Yes, he was quite capable -- he always was naming people. In fact the way I got the name, when I got to New York they were playing in the famous Cafe Society, which was the most high class jazz night club in the world as has ever been. And of course later on Billy Berg had one too in Hollywood, and I came there with Coleman Hawkins later. But this was really an exciting place, a wonderful -- a very beautiful night club, and they had the top entertainment in

the world. At the time that I was playing there they featured such artists as Hazel Scott. Hazel Scott was very often featured there as a solo performer. She played alone and with a trio. And as I said they had this Pete Johnson and Albert Ammons, they played inbetween.
